items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: I was blessed with a couple of very good teachers: Junie Ferrell and Santy Runion

ctx.x: Your books were one of the first on the market. Did you have — how did you test them out? Did you try some of your ideas out with your students before you actually put them in a book?

Mostly I looked backward to how I learned. And I was blessed with a couple of very good teachers: Junie Ferrell and Santy Runion and they were both not only teaching me things but open to what I wanted to learn. And so it gave me a good attitude about studying, about practicing, you labor for these things, get them to come to pass.
Did you have trouble finding a publisher for your books? Especially in the beginning.
